E-Sheet.dc.html.title: E · No stack: a sheet of active missions

C2-Drawer.dc.html.title: C2 · A bigger live folder, and what you can still change

head.text: Missions tab: one Active section instead of Group, Periodic and Story

nToday.text: Today: the stack, then three dividers (Group events, Periodic missions, Story missions), each with what's open, what's next and what's filed.

nA.text: A: the stack stays. One Active divider lists every live mission, soonest first, its kind as a small label. One line says what's coming, one folded line holds everything filed tonight.

nB.text: B: the stack and an Active list, nothing more. Results already land in the Log book, so the filed lines go; one link points there.

nC.text: C: no separate list. The stack's own folder tabs run down the page as an index, one per live mission with its clock; tap one to open it. Filed tonight is a closed folder at the bottom.

nD.text: D: under the stack, two index tabs: Active (live missions and what's coming) and Filed (tonight's results). Tap to switch.

nE.text: E: no swiping stack at all. Every live mission is a card down one sheet, soonest first, with its own button; coming and filed fold at the foot.

nC2.text: C2: the stack as it is today (tap a tab at the top to bring that mission forward), with a bigger front folder: description, then the clock, a tracker row with how many players have answered, and a Submit button. Below, a second folder holds the entries you can still change. Filed tonight closes the page. The bottom tab is now Public file.
